intendedChanges.summary: Remove the express manager-inquiry requirement; Lender can counter by requiring reasonable inquiry on authority and factual assumptions.
Expand permitted reliance from Lender alone to Lender and its subsequent assignees, and remove subsequent assignees from the consent-required list to implement that right.
Extend notice of discovered false closing facts from five to twenty business days; Lender can counter with prompt notice subject to a five-day maximum.
Reduce the preparation and delivery fee from $8,000 to $5,000.
Move the unchanged excluded-regulatory-subjects clause from Section 6 to Section 1.
Replace uncapped contractual liability with a fee-based cap; Lender can counter with an exception for fraud and gross negligence.
Replace retained with kept in the electronic-copy sentence as a neutral wording clean-up.
Replace principally with primarily without changing the knowledge group.
